aorta-12.title: Normal Celiac Trunk & SMA – Longitudinal
aorta-12.label: Proximal aortic long axis
aorta-12.credit: Felipe Urriola P., MD, Emergency Unit, Puerto Aysen Hospital, via The POCUS Atlas
aorta-12.note: Subxiphoid long-axis view of the proximal abdominal aorta, with the celiac trunk and superior mesenteric artery arising anteriorly. The acquired example shows a more proximal level than the modeled aortic target. Different case. One cine frame converted to WebP. Noncommercial reuse only.

aorta-48.title: Normal IVC and Aorta – Transverse View

aorta-48.credit: Felipe Urriola P., MD, Emergency Unit, Puerto Aysen Hospital, via The POCUS Atlas
aorta-48.note: Subxiphoid transverse view of the two great vessels. The aorta is on screen right above the vertebra, and the IVC is on screen left. The acquired level and depth differ from the model. Different case. One cine frame converted to WebP. Noncommercial reuse only.

ivc-12.credit: Justin Bowra and colleagues, via The POCUS Atlas
ivc-12.note: Subcostal long-axis view of the IVC joining the right atrium. It shows a more cranial endpoint than the modeled abdominal segment and includes the right atrium. Different case. One cine frame converted to WebP. Noncommercial reuse only.
